summary: Chat: strip raw CITATIONS block from assistant prose so only styled cards show
description:
In src/components/chat-view.tsx, the assistant message text is rendered raw via ReactMarkdown (line ~380) and the model's CITATIONS tail (always emitted — CORE_RULES, both voices) shows as unstyled plaintext above the already-styled 'References' block (built from chunks_used, line ~384). Remove the duplicate.

CHANGE: before passing msg.text to ReactMarkdown, run it through parseCitationsBlock (C1) and render only the stripped body. The styled References cards already come from msg.citations/chunks_used — leave that path untouched.

EDGE CASE: if a response has NO chunks_used (retrieval empty) the References block is absent; stripping would drop the citations entirely. Acceptable (no retrieval => nothing to cite), but optionally fall back to the parsed citations to populate the cards when msg.citations is empty. Note which you chose.

DECISION (render vs server): default render-time here so existing stored response_text rows are also cleaned and the billing/persist path in api/query/route.ts is untouched. If chosen instead to strip server-side before persisting fullResponse (route.ts:338), document why.

TEST: a chat message whose text contains a CITATIONS tail renders body-only (assert the raw block text is absent from the rendered prose). Depends on C1.

resolution.note: chat-view runs msg.text through parseCitationsBlock: renders stripped body, sources only as styled References cards (chunks_used, or parsed tail as fallback when retrieval attached none). Stats footer now gated on msg.meta. Render-time strip — covers existing stored rows, no billing/persist change.
